subject: On-prem cutover: integration smoke plan and runbook (final)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Clara Jenkins <clara.jenkins@harborbank.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jan 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: On-prem cutover: integration smoke plan & runbook (final)

Team / Clara,

Attached is the final runbook for the on‑prem VPC cutover window next week. Core items I want to call out before we lock dates: 

- Cutover window: Tue 2028-01-10 02:00–06:00 UTC (HarborBank maintenance window confirmed).
- Preflight checklist: BGP peer health, firewall ACL sync, NAT gateways validated, DNS TTL drop to 30s 24h prior.
- Smoke plan (short): 1) KV cache priming, 2) health-check calls to /v1/health on all replicas, 3) 1k synthetic completion tokens through the new VPC path, 4) latency and error sampling, 5) rollback criteria (>=5% 5xxs over 10 min or tail latency >1s).
- Ops bridge: #prod‑cutover (Redwood Slack), call line: +1‑415‑555‑0199 (pin 2391).

Attachments included: RI-vpc-cutover-runbook-final-v2.pdf (primary), smoke-results-20280110.csv (template for post-run results). Please review the runbook and call out any missing operational steps by EOD tomorrow.

Action items for internal: Lauren — confirm telemetry retention/aggregation queries; Markus — verify ACL sync job and provide fallback commands.

Clara / HarborBank: please confirm your ramp and drain procedure and whether the load‑balancer VIP switch will be manual or automated. Also share any network ACL change window for your edge firewall.

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Deployment Lead, Redwood Inference
--
RI | diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
attachments: RI-vpc-cutover-runbook-final-v2.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB), smoke-results-20280110.csv (CSV, template)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Clara Jenkins <clara.jenkins@harborbank.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jan 2028 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem cutover: integration smoke plan & runbook (final)

Diego — thanks, reviewed. Quick notes: 

- Telemetry: I'll push a temporary metrics pipeline to retain high‑resolution traces for a 48h window post‑cutover (we'll export to the cutover S3 bucket).
- Canary set: propose 5% traffic for first 15m, then 20% for next 30m if stable. I put the exact queries in the Confluence page link you shared.
- DNS TTL drop: I'll schedule the TTL change tonight and confirm once propagated.

Question for HarborBank: can you confirm whether the LB VIP swap will also update the HTTP healthcheck path? If not, we'll run health pings from our edge to ensure early detection.

I attached a short checklist that includes the Prometheus alert names and the Grafana dashboard links we'll monitor.

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Clara Jenkins <clara.jenkins@harborbank.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jan 2028 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem cutover: integration smoke plan & runbook (final)

Diego / Lauren / Clara — quick network items from my side: 

- ACL sync: the script in the runbook (section 4.2) assumes HarborBank will accept the CIDR range update on the east edge. Clara, please confirm the exact ACL entry name (we need that for the rollback).
- Fallback command: if the sync fails, run `ri-netctl rollback-acl --id HB-EAST-ACL --prev` (documented in the runbook appendix).
- BGP: please ensure your ASN announce to our ASN 64512 is set to community 64512:10 for the maintenance window.

Also flagging a small change: add a step to capture iperf3 snapshots pre and post switch — useful to correlate latency jumps. I'll add the iperf tool invocation and upload the stub logs to the Drive folder.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Network Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
--
RI | markus_klein@redwood.ai

From: Clara Jenkins <clara.jenkins@harborbank.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@netsys.io>
Date: Tue, 9 Jan 2028 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: On-prem cutover: integration smoke plan & runbook (final)

Diego / team — confirmed on our side. Answers: 

- LB VIP swap: manual. Our runbook requires manual approval from two HarborBank operators; we'll be on the bridge for that action.
- ACL entry: the rule ID is HB-EDGE-ACL-204; we've scheduled the change at 02:05 UTC and will hold the change if you trigger rollback.
- BGP community: we'll announce with community 64512:10 as requested.
- We'll capture a pcap and provide the files if you need deeper analysis (Alyssa will coordinate).

One ask: please include the HarborBank oncall number in the bridge header (we will call into the conference line). Also, if you have a short list of exact test cases for the smoke csv template, send them and we'll run them from our side too.

Thanks,
Clara Jenkins
Platform Ops Lead, HarborBank
--
External attachments: harbor-acl-change-request.pdf (signed), HB-oncall.txt

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Clara Jenkins <clara.jenkins@harborbank.com>, HarborBank Platform Ops <ops@harborbank.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 06:48:00 -0800
Subject: Post-cutover: initial smoke summary and artifacts

Team / HarborBank — closing the loop with an initial readout from the 02:00–05:45 UTC cutover window: 

Summary (high level):
- Cutover completed at 02:37 UTC. VIP swap performed manually at 02:35 UTC after two HarborBank approvals.
- Rollback not required.
- Smoke results: 1k synthetic tokens executed (see attached CSV). Error rate across producers: 0.8% 5xxs (within go/no-go threshold). 95th p50 latency uplift +80ms for the first 20m, normalized thereafter.
- Notable: a transient ACL replication delay caused a ~3 minute increase in 5xxs around 02:34–02:37; Markus's rollback command was staged but not executed.

Artifacts attached: smoke-results-20280110.csv (filled), network-snap-logs-0108-0110.tar.gz (iperf snapshots + system logs).

Next steps: 
1) Lauren to publish the high‑resolution traces into the cutover S3 and run the error correlation dashboard.
2) Markus to follow up with a small ACL replication hardening change (post mortem ticket JIRA-RI-4521).
3) HarborBank to upload the pcap if deeper packet analysis is required.

Thanks for the smooth coordination — will follow up with a short post‑mortem doc tomorrow.

Diego Fernandez
Deployment Lead, Redwood Inference
--
attachments: smoke-results-20280110.csv (CSV, 45KB), network-snap-logs-0108-0110.tar.gz (tgz, 6.2MB)

Perfect — thanks everyone. Quick notes from telemetry: 

- Trace export completed to s3://ri-cutover-archives/harborbank/2028-01-10 by 12:30 UTC. I've run the baseline error-correlation and opened JIRA-RI-4521 to track the ACL replication fix with a P2 target.
- Action: I'll schedule the PM for a 30‑minute post‑mortem with HarborBank and owners next day (agenda: ACL replication root cause, mitigations, improvement to runbook steps).

Closing this thread — excellent coordination.

Lauren Bishop
